Do you want to work to make Power for Good?

We're the world's largest independent renewable energy company, guided by a simple yet powerful vision to create a future where everyone has access to affordable, zero carbon energy.

We know that achieving our ambitions would be impossible without our people. Because we're tackling some of the world's toughest problems, we need the very best people to help us. They're our most important asset so that's why we continually invest in them.

Our competitive package offers a wide range of benefits and rewards. 

The position

The Associate Project Manager will manage engineering and related issues across a broad range of cross portfolio projects. The role may be involved in Wind, Solar & Battery Storage projects, assisting Asset Managers and Site Managers in the Management of the RES Asset Management, ensuring adherence to best practice for safety, quality, and environmental performance throughout the project lifecycle.

The role will form part of the Operations Support and Advisory Team who support the Global Asset Management Teams with the integration and adoption of projects into the portfolio, as well as the implementation of new services that are developed by the team.

The Associate Project Manager will report to the Senior Operations Support Manager, joining a team of Associate Project Managers with broad experience across Wind, Solar and Battery Storage. They will have an influential role as part of the Operations Support and Advisory Team in leading, developing and ensuring the performance of the Additional Services that are provided to our customers. Additional services are those outside the scope of our Asset Management agreements.

The Associate Project Manager shall work across all disciplines, understanding the procurement, contract, technical and site requirements related to each project.

The role will promote and enhance the Operations Support and Advisory Team and shall be highly visible role within Asset Management, with occasional travel required to regional offices or sites within the portfolio. The role can be based in any of our regions where we have an Asset Management presence, there will be opportunities to support projects in other regions or countries.

Help ensure high HSQE standards across our portfolio

  • Ensuring compliance and deliverables are met, including direct supervision of various works and oversight of contractors as required

 Act as Project Manager on Cyber Assessment of operational assets by:

  • Working with 3rd party suppliers to deliver Cyber Security Assessments
  • Working with RES Operational Technology Team to upgrade OT hardware on operational assets and maintain the hardware

Support the Operations Support and Advisory Team by:

  • Leading on areas of personal expertise as part of the Operations Support and Advisory Team objectives.
  • Actively participating in Continuous Improvement, Innovation and Standardisation activities to develop RES services

  • Health and safety management systems
  • CDM Regulations
  • Quality and environmental management systems
  • Project financial management
  • Fluency in English with knowledge of other languages advantageous (French and / or Spanish)

Skills

  • People Management
  • Teamwork
  • Communication
  • Initiative
  • Self-motivated
  • Planning and organising
  • Attention to Detail
  • Completer finisher

Job Description:

Global Subsurface Solutions (GSS) is a global organisation within Subsurface which delivers high-quality, fit for purpose subsurface technical products to address critical business challenges across bp’s subsurface businesses, including oil, gas and low carbon projects. 

GSS Geologists are deployed as part of an integrated, multi-disciplinary agile squad (GSS-led or Region-led), where they work as individual contributors or squad leads to support resource progression and reservoir management, evaluate new opportunities, progress low carbon energy projects, and develop and deploy digital and data solutions. 

GSS geologists work on clastic deep-water, paralic, non-marine reservoirs, and carbonate reservoirs, supporting all phases of business activity from early access to late-life field management. 

What you will deliver 

As an Integrated Geologist in GSS you will use your deep technical skills in geology, your business insight, a bias for subsurface cross-discipline integration, and a thorough appreciation of subsurface uncertainty and risk management, to deliver integrated subsurface solutions that inform business decisions across bp’s global oil and gas portfolio. 

  • Interpreting and integrating core, well-log, seismic, analogue, and dynamic data (pressure, production etc.) to develop and refine integrated frameworks. 
  • Developing subsurface scenarios to characterise and communicate uncertainties. 
  • Communicating subsurface uncertainty to colleagues and business leaders. 
  • Delivering high-quality subsurface characterisation of the reservoir and/or overburden. 
  • Coaching and mentoring, sharing best practice and seeking input from SMEs. 
  • Sharing best practice. 

Experience and Qualifications

  • BSc or higher in Geology, Geociences, Earth Sciences or equivalent 
  • Experience in exploration, appraisal, development, production geoscience and/or low carbon projects. 
  • Skilful at geoscience and subsurface integration skills, including interpretation workstation skills. 
  • Skilful at characterising and communicating subsurface uncertainty and risk. 
  • Capable at integrating static and dynamic subsurface data. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
  • A collaborative, team-first ethos. 
  • A proven track-record of personal delivery. 
  • Ability to work effectively in split-site squads. 

You will work with 

GSS Integrated Geologists have two main interfaces: the GSS O&G Solutions Geology team and Region teams. You will work with integrated geologists to share best practice and technical insight, and engage with regional teams and leadership to provide project updates and deliver integrated technical insights.

jobTitle: Design Manager, EMEA Portfolio, Design, Sustainability & Engineering
jobDescription:
Description

The Global Design team is looking for a creative, innovative, results-oriented designer based in Luxembourg, Madrid or London who will be responsible for the design of select new buildings or expansion projects post-occupancy tenant improvement in Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) portfolio. This role will join the Global Design team, reporting to the EMEA Design Manager, and will work closely with the EMEA Design & Construction (D&C) teams, the Workplace Guidelines & Standards team and the Global Transformation & Insights team.

This role will be responsible for the oversight of the design of “post-occupancy” tenant improvement projects, which means updating, revising and evolving the design of a space where Amazonians are currently working, and small/medium new site projects (new sites) or expansions. The project scope ranges from the design of several floors of a building to suit the needs and behaviors of a new team, to the design of smaller specialty spaces, to developing an overall design solution that can improve the workplace that can be applied to multiple projects (for example, an improvement to acoustics, lighting, or furniture). Over time, this role should gain familiarity with Amazon’s EMEA corporate workplace portfolio in order to pro-actively identify and recommend design solutions for certain buildings or spaces. This role will work closely with the EMEA D&C team and sub-consultants/vendors on project delivery.

The successful candidate is an experienced, and engaging professional who can communicate clearly at all levels, and yet is not afraid to dive deep into details. This role works autonomously and creatively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, and will be working on multiple projects and initiatives, most of which have very tight delivery timelines. Attention to detail and ability to inspect issues and processes brings simplified solutions to complex problems is paramount. They should also understand the nuance of being approachable, while at the same time consultative. The candidate must be able to balance frugality with creativity in offering solutions and approach problem-solving with an emphasis on root cause.

This is a Regional role focused on the EMEA region, so requires regional travel approximately 20-30% of the time. At Amazon, we also believe that in-person collaboration is essential to our culture and innovation. While we allow flexibility for personal circumstances, we generally expect employees to work from our offices five days a week. This approach has consistently shown that spontaneous interactions, rapid problem-solving, and the energy of in-person teamwork lead to better results for our customers. In particular, our data shows that teams working together in person are more effective at making complex decisions, onboarding new team members, and fostering the kind of creative collaboration that has driven Amazon's success. The serendipitous hallway conversations and impromptu whiteboarding sessions that happen naturally in an office environment have proven invaluable to our invention process and maintaining our high bar for excellence.

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee and manage the design of post-occupancy tenant improvement projects and small/medium new site projects and expansions, to include (1) leading the design of the space based on customer needs and technical requirements; (2) on some projects of a certain size/scale/priority, collaborate with an external/vendor design team (the Architect of Record) (3) align the design of each project to the overall concept for Corporate Workplace, as developed by the Global Design team; and (4) inform Guidelines and Standards team on design elements needed to translate into global functional Guidelines..
- Identify and implement continuous design refinement, leveraging operational data, customer insights, and success metrics to drive change.
- Work cross functionally with regional peers to ensure a consistent experience for customers, whilst respecting local/cultural nuance.
- Collaborate with GREF partner teams, including Regional Portfolio Management, Sustainability and Environmental Health and Safety, and Travel and Events, to elevate program deliverables and improve the quality of Amazon workspace with a focus on resiliency, efficiency, health, and safety.
- Routinely connect to external industry, professional bodies and communities, ensuring new industry standards, best practices, technology, and innovations are adopted into the program.


A day in the life
Day-to-day, this role will mainly collaborate with the EMEA Constrution team responsible for construction and delivery of projects. Also collaborate with external vendors as local project managers and design team (Architect of Record). Once projects are delivered, this role will work with the Workplace Guidelines & Standards team to indicate what design elements need to be integrated, including producing visuals and narratives that can be translated and published as Guidelines. The role will need also to be able to work in conjunction with other stakeholders to develop any process improvement initiatives or programs related to workplace design.

About the team
The Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team manages Amazon's real estate and facilities globally. It's organized into Regional Portfolio Management, Global Centers of Enablement, and Global Centers of Expertise. Design, Sustainability and Engineering includes Global Design, Workplace Guidelines, Sustainability, and Engineering teams. These teams develop design concepts, implement workplace standards, and deliver various spaces across Amazon's portfolio. GREF emphasizes inclusive team culture, work-life balance, and career growth. The team values diversity and promotes knowledge sharing and mentorship. GREF strives to create spaces that support Amazonians' work while enhancing employee well-being and aligning with the company's strategic vision.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience as a Producer, UX Program Manager, Research Program Manager, or similar role in a user experience or design team
- Experience in UX research
- Experience leading large projects through the full product development life cycle in a large, cross-functional team
- Experience with web-based design tooling and project management software (Jira, Wrike, Workfront, etc.)
- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Experience in project and program management

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in facilities management, or experience in construction or project management
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)
- Knowledge of key technology and market trends
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Experience identifying, mitigating, and managing business risks and tradeoffs
- • Familiarity with relevant industry codes, standards, and regulatory requirements.
- • Able to build constructive and effective relationships and use them to maneuver through complex situations.

jobTitle: Engineering & Construction Underwriter (Hybrid Work, 80 - 100% working degree possible)
jobDescription:
Interested in helping insure the UK's most complex construction and infrastructure projects?

Join Swiss Re Corporate Solutions and play a key role in underwriting major UK construction projects—from buildings to transport and energy infrastructure, data centers, and industrial facilities.

This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive underwriter with construction insurance experience to deepen their technical expertise, develop a sustainable portfolio and build a long-term career with a leading global insurer.

About the Role

As an Engineering & Construction Underwriter based in London, you'll be responsible for underwriting a portfolio of UK construction risks, partnering with brokers, clients, risk engineers, and claims specialists to deliver effective insurance solutions.

You will build on your existing construction underwriting experience while gaining exposure to major projects across the UK construction sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess and underwrite Construction All Risks (CAR), Erection All Risks (EAR), Delay in Start-Up (DSU) and other related construction covers.
  • Analyse construction project information, including contractors, construction methods, technologies, schedules and risk controls
  • Negotiate policy terms, conditions, and pricing with brokers and clients
  • Monitor project performance throughout the construction lifecycle and support risk management initiatives
  • Collaborate with Risk Engineering and Claims colleagues to investigate losses and develop practical solutions
  • Manage policy amendments and coverage changes as projects evolve
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with relevant stakeholder including brokers, contractors, project owners, etc
  • Continue developing technical underwriting expertise through Swiss Re's structured training and development programmes

About the Team

Our London Engineering & Construction team underwrites a broad portfolio of construction business across the UK and internationally. The team reviews projects ranging from:

  • Residential, mixed-use and commercial developments
  • Data centres
  • Industrial, manufacturing and warehouse facilities
  • Transport infrastructure
  • Power and utility projects
  • Mining
  • Oil, gas and petrochemical projects.
  • Renewable energy construction, including solar, wind, and battery storage projects

You'll join an experienced and collaborative team of underwriters committed to technical excellence, continuous learning, and providing innovative solutions to clients operating in an increasingly complex construction environment.

About You

You have experience within construction insurance and are looking to develop your career within a highly respected and technically focused underwriting team. You enjoy interpreting project information, analysing risks, and building trusted relationships with brokers and clients. You are commercially minded, detail-oriented, and motivated to continuously expand your knowledge of the UK construction sector.

We're looking for candidates with:

  • Experience within construction / engineering underwriting, property underwriting, broker placement, or technical insurance support roles
  • Exposure to Construction All Risks (CAR), Engineering All Risks (EAR), Property, or Specialty Lines of business
  • Strong analytical skills and sound underwriting judgement
  • Good understanding of UK construction projects and associated risk exposures
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation and relationship-management skills
  • Strong IT skills

We'd particularly welcome candidates with:

  • Knowledge of major contractor and developer-led projects
  • London Market experience
  • Experience working with multinational clients and programmes
  • Progress towards or completion of ACII or other professional insurance qualifications

Why Join Swiss Re Corporate Solutions?

This role offers the opportunity to work on some of the UK's most significant construction projects while developing specialist expertise within a global organisation known for technical excellence. You'll benefit from structured development, exposure to complex risks, and clear opportunities for career progression within one of the world's leading commercial insurers.

Whether your experience comes from a construction underwriting team, a broker, or another specialty insurance environment, this is an opportunity to accelerate your career and become a recognised Engineering & Construction underwriting specialist.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week. #LI-Hybrid

For London the annual base salary range for this position is between GBP 63 000 and GBP 95 000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

  • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
  • the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions 

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
